name: Generic single driver with 6-band PEQ
notes: Example for a full-range speaker whose ESPHome component exposes PEQ bands as number entities (frequency, gain, Q) and optionally a type select. Copy it and change the hints, ranges and YAML template to match your component.

media_player.label: Media player that plays the test noise

yaml_template:
# Speaker Tuner {{tool_version}}: {{profile_name}}
# Device: {{device_name}}, exported {{date}}
#
# A generic profile can't know your component's YAML, so this exports the values as
# substitutions. Wire them into your component's config, for example:
#
#   my_eq_component:
#     bands:
#       - frequency: ${peq_1_frequency}Hz
#         gain: ${peq_1_gain}dB
#         q: ${peq_1_q}
#
# Better: copy this profile, and replace this template with your component's own
# config so the export pastes straight in. See "Writing a profile" in the README.
# A band with gain 0 is off.

substitutions:
  peq_1_frequency: "{{peq_1_frequency}}"
  peq_1_gain: "{{peq_1_gain}}"
  peq_1_q: "{{peq_1_q}}"
  peq_1_type: "{{peq_1_type_code}}"
  peq_2_frequency: "{{peq_2_frequency}}"
  peq_2_gain: "{{peq_2_gain}}"
  peq_2_q: "{{peq_2_q}}"
  peq_2_type: "{{peq_2_type_code}}"
  peq_3_frequency: "{{peq_3_frequency}}"
  peq_3_gain: "{{peq_3_gain}}"
  peq_3_q: "{{peq_3_q}}"
  peq_3_type: "{{peq_3_type_code}}"
  peq_4_frequency: "{{peq_4_frequency}}"
  peq_4_gain: "{{peq_4_gain}}"
  peq_4_q: "{{peq_4_q}}"
  peq_4_type: "{{peq_4_type_code}}"
  peq_5_frequency: "{{peq_5_frequency}}"
  peq_5_gain: "{{peq_5_gain}}"
  peq_5_q: "{{peq_5_q}}"
  peq_5_type: "{{peq_5_type_code}}"
  peq_6_frequency: "{{peq_6_frequency}}"
  peq_6_gain: "{{peq_6_gain}}"
  peq_6_q: "{{peq_6_q}}"
  peq_6_type: "{{peq_6_type_code}}"
